name: Alternate Character Set Handling Scheme
citation: HL7 v2.7.1 Appendix A, HL7 Table 0356 - Alternate Character Set Handling Scheme

entries.description: This is the default, indicating that there is no character set switching occurring in this message.
The character set switching mode specified in HL7 2.5, section 2.7.2 and section 2.A.46, "XPN - extended person name".
This standard is titled "Information Technology - Character Code Structure and Extension Technique". .
